task.description:
Implement API-11 (OpenAPI specification) according to src/design/api-openapi.md.

Required outcomes:
- Add unauthenticated GET /openapi.json endpoint that returns a valid OpenAPI 3.1 JSON document
- OpenAPI document MUST be code-generated (typed builder/registry/descriptor flow), not a static hand-maintained JSON file
- Ensure info.version is sourced from platform release version (build.zig.zon / build options strategy described in design)
- Include documented endpoints and shared RFC 9457 problem detail error shapes in the generated doc
- Keep implementation extensible for API-12 and future endpoint descriptors

Validation required in this handoff:
- zig build
- zig build test
- Confirm /openapi.json route is public (no auth middleware requirement)

Update this handoff result with all touched artifacts and any issues.
acceptance_criteria: GET /openapi.json endpoint exists and is publicly accessible
OpenAPI output is generated from code structures (no static spec file source)
OpenAPI version is 3.1.x and info.version matches platform version source
Shared error response schemas are represented in components

result.summary: Implemented API-11 with a code-generated OpenAPI 3.1 pipeline and public GET /openapi.json handler. Added typed model/registry/path-descriptor/builder/serializer modules, wired version sourcing through build options from build.zig.zon, included shared RFC 9457 problem schemas/responses in components, and documented existing definitions/instances/tasks endpoints plus /openapi.json with unauthenticated security override.
